parts.text: I keep our drones and charging equipment in working order, which involves adding new drones to the fleet, retiring old ones, and setting up charging pads at our sites. I also take drones out of service for repairs and put them back, as well as send drones to charge. Regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after. I worry when instructions sent to the drones and charging equipment get through twice or when the sender cannot tell whether the first attempt arrived, and when radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather.
